input.summary: The masonry shell is built: plinth, brick walls on both storeys, pavilions, podium, tower shaft, floors at y3, y10 and y16, partitions, two stair flights and the tower ladder. make.sh gives a whole build.nbt, and 9 of the 11 rooms are walkable (the clock room and belfry are up the ladder). I did not read the render tiles. Openings and reserved cells are left as air, along with the cells the dressings part will fill.
left: The office doors are at x10 and x30, z16, instead of z20 as planned, because the stair flights block x11..12 and x28..29 at z18..24. Room designers should use the z16 doors.
The ladder cells at x21 z13 y27..31 show as unsupported until the dressings fill the tower's z14 wall (clock-face cells and the y27 and y31 bands) behind them.
The clock room and belfry show as unreachable in `mcd walk`, probably because it doesn't climb ladders. I did not confirm that.

Dressings have to fill the cells I left empty: the y10 and y16 wall rings, the tower rings at y27, y31 and y35, the quoin corner columns, the clock-face cells, and the y9 arch rows over the windows. They can't use over:true, since runParts refuses writes into earlier parts' cells.
Not all quoin cells are covered. I left only the corner columns empty (the 4 front pavilion corners and the 2 rear corners); the neighbouring 'long' course cells are brick.

`mcd check` also reports 6 unsupported ladder cells (the ones above) and 24 orphan blocks. Most of the orphans are smooth_quartz at x3 and z27 from the roof part. I did not investigate the 4 orphan bricks at z26 y11 (x5, x18, x22, x35).

waste.what: I worked out the window, door, arch and quoin exclusion boxes from the OPENINGS table by hand, as open() calls.
waste.cost: about 25 box calls, 1 retry because a blanket open() on the y10 string course also blocked the floor
waste.tool: A helper that reads plan.md's OPENINGS and RESERVED tables and returns an air mask, with a `wallsWithOpenings` brush that fills a wall except for those boxes.

waste.what: I found that the office doors at z20 collided with the stair flights only after `mcd walk` reported the offices unreachable.
waste.tool: A plan-consistency check that overlays ROOMS doors on the stairFlight footprints before building.

companions.task: Lay the quoin courses in the same pass as the walls, so the mason can leave no empty cells for another part to fill.
Place the hall stairs and check headroom and doorway clearance on the ground and upper floors.
